name: Alex Padilla
bio: California's first Latino Senator, focusing heavily on immigration reform, voting rights, and federal climate legislation.

name: Adam Schiff
bio: Former U.S. Representative known for leading intelligence committees, focusing on democratic institution protection and housing.

name: Gavin Newsom
bio: Governor of California pushing progressive climate policies and aggressively challenging local zoning laws to force housing construction.

name: Karen Bass
bio: Mayor of Los Angeles and former U.S. Rep, dedicating her administration to declaring a state of emergency on homelessness.

name: Mark Warner
bio: Moderate Democrat and tech entrepreneur focusing on national security, intelligence, and bipartisan economic policies.

name: Tim Kaine
bio: Former Governor and VP nominee prioritizing career and technical education, armed services support, and healthcare access.

name: Glenn Youngkin
bio: Former private equity CEO who won the governorship focusing on parents' rights in education, tax cuts, and rolling back regulations.

name: Morgan Griffith
bio: Conservative Representative for Southwest Virginia (including Blacksburg), advocating for coal industries and reduced federal spending.

name: Leslie Hager-Smith
bio: Long-serving Mayor of Blacksburg, focused on town-gown relations with Virginia Tech, sustainability, and local infrastructure.

name: Chuck Schumer
bio: Senate Majority Leader championing major federal investments in infrastructure, climate, and semiconductor manufacturing.

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
bio: Senator prioritizing paid family leave, military justice reform, and agricultural policies for upstate New York.

name: Kathy Hochul
bio: First female Governor of NY, focused on economic recovery, massive housing pacts, and gun control legislation.

name: Eric Adams
bio: Former police captain and current Mayor, running on a platform of public safety, business recovery, and the 'City of Yes' zoning reform.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
bio: Progressive icon and author of the Green New Deal, advocating strongly for universal healthcare and tenant rights.

name: Patty Murray
bio: Senior Senator and President pro tempore, focused heavily on education, labor rights, and veterans affairs.

name: Maria Cantwell
bio: Senator known for her work on tech regulation, aviation safety, and protecting public lands in the Pacific Northwest.

name: Bob Ferguson
bio: Former State Attorney General elected Governor, known for aggressive consumer protection lawsuits and strong environmental defense.

name: Bruce Harrell
bio: Mayor pushing a 'One Seattle' agenda focused on increasing police staffing and clearing unauthorized encampments.

name: Pramila Jayapal
bio: Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, leading pushes for Medicare for All and comprehensive immigration reform.

name: Ted Cruz
bio: Outspoken conservative Senator known for strict constitutionalist views, deregulation, and strong opposition to federal overreach.

name: John Cornyn
bio: Senior Texas Senator known as a reliable conservative vote who occasionally engages in bipartisan legislation like the CHIPS Act.

name: Greg Abbott
bio: Governor of Texas championing massive border security operations, school voucher programs, and broad tax cuts.

name: Kirk Watson
bio: Returning Mayor of Austin, balancing the city's progressive roots with intense infrastructure and housing affordability challenges.
